observations.name: original files and strict guard source unchanged

scope: 30 actual storage cases: Native, its generated HWPX and independent original HWPX; five edit modes and both formats. Each case requires three disk reopen cycles, a retained edit on that reopened instance, both output formats and both instance-local undo/redo. All original semantics/layout/text and full production guards remain strict. No Hancom GUI, user document writes or real LLM.
